title: Zone 1 (Valley) — Water Tastes Like Bleach, Customers Vomiting

fields.subject: Call from Zone 1 (Valley): Water tastes like bleach, has chemical smell. Customers are vomiting. 40 calls in 10 minutes.
fields.description: Water has a bitter taste, chemical smell, and has caused nausea and vomiting. One family has taken a child to the ER. Demand for bottled water is high. 40 calls received in 10 minutes. Critical customer status activated.

activity.author: Customer Service Agent (Zone 1 (Valley))
activity.text: This is a high-priority, urgent call from Zone 1 (Valley). Customers report water tastes like bleach, has a chemical smell, and has caused vomiting. One family has taken a child to the ER. 40 calls in 10 minutes. Critical customer status activated.

activity.author: System
activity.text: Ticket created. Priority set to Critical. Alert sent to Customer Service Lead, PIO, and Director of Water Operations.

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

instructorNote: This inject confirms the public health emergency. The PIO must log it in the media and rumor log. The Customer Service Lead must open the surge line and distribute call scripts. The WQ Manager must validate the lab data against this report.
